management.title: Photo album
management.description: Create a curated photo album from your Photo Wall and share it with your guests.

name.label: Album name
name.error: Unable to save the album name.

statusCard.title: Photo album status
statusCard.description: Manage the availability of your photo album.

published.title: Photo album is published
published.description: Guests with access to the link can view the photo album and the photos you have chosen to share.
published.success: The photo album is no longer publicly available.

draft.title: Photo album is not published
draft.description: Guests cannot access the photo album until you publish it and make it available for sharing.
draft.success: The photo album has been published successfully.

publicLinkCard.title: Public link
publicLinkCard.description: Share the public link to your photo album.

active.title: Public link is active
active.description: Anyone with this link can view the photo album.

inactive.title: Public link is not active
inactive.description: The link will become available to guests after the photo album is published.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Manage the photos displayed in this album.

empty.title: Your album is empty
empty.description: Add photos from your Photo Wall to your photo album.

picker.title: Add photos
picker.description: Select photos from the Photo Wall that you want to add to the album.
picker.error: Unable to add photos to the album.

all.title: No photos
all.description: There are no photos in the Photo Wall available to add yet.

favorites.title: No favorites
favorites.description: You haven't marked any photos as favorites yet.

delete.title: Delete photo album
delete.description: Permanently delete this photo album and its photo selection.

confirm.title: Delete photo album?
confirm.description: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
